canada.title: One last afternoon in the park for Bailey
canada.summary: Bailey the dog was diagnosed with cancer this year, and her owners are doing everything they can to make sure she has the best time before she is gone. canada.title: One person still missing after fishing boat capsized near Yale, B.C., search and rescue says
canada.summary: One person is still unaccounted for after a fishing boat reportedly capsized on the Fraser River in Yale, B.C., Friday afternoon. In a post to Facebook, Hope Volunteer Search and Rescue said the operation quickly turned into a search, after personnel were told there was another person in the water.

canada.title: Holiday spirit alive in Saskatchewan despite warm weather, lack of snow
canada.summary: It's one of the warmest Novembers on record for Saskatchewan, but that's not stopping people from enjoying the festive season, with Santa Claus parades and holiday markets around the province.

canada.title: Paulatuk, N.W.T., looks to protect historical graveyard from shoreline erosion
canada.summary: Cape Parry used to be a home to Inuit in the 1950s and '60s who later moved to Paulatuk. Erosion is now threatening a small graveyard at the former settlement.
